name: pit fiend

actions.name: diabolical restoration
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

actions.name: fear aura
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} emanates an aura in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=oT8238p9jXwVy76c]]-foot Emanation while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=oT8238p9jXwVy76c]], [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=oT8238p9jXwVy76c]]. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s aura for 24 hours.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .mmBite0000000000]] attack, two [[/item .mmDevilishClaw00]] attacks, and one [[/item .mmFieryMace00000]] attack.

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a creature, it must make the following saving throw. Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=fM7YmQ4hBtRXJkMe]]. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points and takes [[/damage average activity=aa2GUeTEVLOdmfrB]] damage at the start of each of its turns, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: hellfire spellcasting
actions.desc: The pit fiend casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFireball00]{Fireball} (level 5 version) twice, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @abilities.cha.dc]]).. It can replace one Fireball with @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHoldMonste]{Hold Monster} (level 7 version) or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWallofFire]{Wall of Fire}.
